title: Expeditor
description: Official Archirodon project role in Saudi Arabia focused on procurement expediting for newly awarded project operations. The role covers organizing and coordinating expediting activities, executing procurement work for materials, services, and sub-contracts, and helping meet project delivery requirements in an EPC oil-and-gas construction environment. The listing asks for 2-5 years of field procurement expediting experience in construction, plus professional English; Arabic is an advantage.
